disqualification.detail: Value head trained on corrupted value targets (masked rows decoded to a non-loss class by never-committed 2026-10-20 run-time code). Never valid as a value prior (MCTS init or RL warm start); policy-head measurements from these artifacts remain documented but no strength claim is attached.
disqualification.evidence: A-02 supervised-learning audit (audit/supervised-learning-quality-20261030 @ 4d7fe4f), remediated 2026-10-31 on fix/supervised-learning-remediation-20261031. Forensic chain: (1) scaled checkpoint's AdamW state carries step=24,325 with non-zero first/second moments for all 7 value-head tensors while the current dataset train split is 100% masked (255) and current code yields exactly zero value gradient on those bytes; (2) finetune checkpoint carries optimizer state for exactly all except the 7 value tensors, and its value weights are bit-identical to the scaled checkpoint's; (3) held-out probes: P(predict loss)=0.0000, per-class CE on loss rows = 18.1, WDL CE 6.8-7.0 vs uniform 1.099. Both value heads were trained on corrupted targets produced by the never-committed 2026-10-20 run-time code.
disqualification.successor: New baseline to be produced by the 2026-10-31 remediation: rebuilt dataset_training (schema-2, genuine WDL labels, receipts) + seeded controlled retraining. Files on disk are preserved unmodified for archaeology.
